list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden — names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to chase directly. Treat it as the finish line: the roadmap in this guide orders the other 54 so the platinum lands last. It is the only platinum-grade trophy on the list.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission, and this pops. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed — just play the opening. It also marks the start of Chapter 1.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies pop as the story moves on, so keep following the mission markers. Nothing optional is needed for it.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. By this chapter both protagonists are playable, which opens up more of the map's activities. Keep to the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Story trophies are unmissable, so there is no side task to finish first. It pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. You are one chapter from the finale at this point, so it is a good moment to clear the missable trophy and any side strands before the story ends.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission and this gold pops. Before starting it, save the game by hand — several guides note there is no mission replay, so a manual save is your only way back. Once the credits roll, the platinum is one 100% completion away.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). No-mission-replay warning: Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list. Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies pop when the mission ends — the description asks only for completion, not for optional objectives. It is unmissable as long as you play the mission.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so this pops in the natural course of the campaign. No preparation outside the mission is needed.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies, it asks only that the mission be finished. Play it when the story offers it.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. The name is a story spoiler in itself, which is why PlayStation hides it until earned. Finish the mission and it pops.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The name points at Vice City International Airport, so expect this one in an airport-set mission. Finish it and the trophy is yours.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The title suggests a large set-piece mission; as with every mission trophy, completion alone is what counts.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which PlayStation tracks as a target of 100. This is the long grind behind the platinum: story, stranger strands, activities and collectibles all feed the percentage. Leave it for last and let the rest of the roadmap fill the bar, then check the in-game stats page for what is still missing.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/100). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near misses and long airtime, as the game counts them. Stunts build up naturally while driving fast around Leonida, so chase them in free roam rather than during missions. PlayStation tracks progress toward 250.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/250). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once; PlayStation tracks 0/9. The nine are the game's side activities — racing, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, drone races, meditation and the rest. Sample one of each early so you know which ones you enjoy grinding later.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/9). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — PlayStation tracks 0/42. Gold medals are the hard part of this list, so expect to revisit the range with better weapons and steady aim. Each challenge's gold target is shown in the range itself.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/42). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations; PlayStation tracks 0/14. Drone races are a distinct activity from road races, so do not confuse the two counters. A win at each location, not just any 14 wins, is what counts.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/14). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; PlayStation tracks 0/20. 'Different' is the key word — winning the same race twice does not add to the count. Work through the race list and tick off new ones.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/20). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival, so this is a head-to-head challenge rather than casual fishing. Fish until the challenge appears, then out-fish him.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — any one, all the way through. Arcade cabinets are scattered around Leonida; pick the game you find easiest and finish a full run. One completion is enough.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, one of the strangers met across Leonida. Stranger strands are chains of side missions, so keep answering Andy's calls and markers until his story ends. This is the last mission of his strand.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Like Andy's strand, this is the last mission in a chain of side missions for a stranger. Follow Kenton's markers to the end of his story.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand ends here; finish his missions in order and this pops at the last one. Stranger missions can be done between story chapters.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida; PlayStation tracks 0/8. There are more strands than eight, so pick the eight you reach first — the five named strangers in this guide (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus Bret's hunt and others all count.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/8). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is one of the eight that count toward Strangers & Freaks, so finishing it does double duty. Follow his missions to their end.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand ends with this mission; like the other stranger finals, it is the last link in a chain of side missions. Finish it and the strand is done.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida; PlayStation tracks 0/18. This is the list's one missable trophy: guides report that one meditation spot, on Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1, disappears after that chapter, and there is no mission replay — so meditate there during Chapter 1, before the chapter ends. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as insurance. The other spots stay available.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/18). Missable warning: Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list; GTA Vibes — GTA 6 trophy list (Chapter 1 meditation, no mission replay).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is a hunting one: the 'unique animal' is a specific target, not any animal. Take Bret's missions until the hunt is offered, then bring the target down.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets; PlayStation tracks 0/3. Cards are hidden around Leonida in sets, so this is a pure collectible hunt. Gather cards set by set — three finished sets is the target, not every card in the game.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/3). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations; PlayStation tracks 0/100. WAiNK is the in-game social app, and 'WAiNK It' means checking in at a place — do it at 100 distinct spots. Spread it across your travels so the count climbs as you explore.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/100). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges; PlayStation tracks 0/50. Challenges are the game's small goals scattered through activities and free roam. They accumulate across everything you do, so this pops late in a thorough playthrough.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/50). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need both protagonists together and the law at four stars, then break line of sight until the wanted level clears. A fast car and open road help; losing the cops at four stars is the hard part.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The trick is the 'back-to-back' chain: hit three shops in a row while the wanted level stays up — do not let it clear between robberies. Plan a route with three close shops and keep moving.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles; PlayStation tracks 0/100. 'Discover' means finding new vehicle models — drive, steal and sit in as many different cars, bikes and boats as you can. Variety counts, not repeats of the same model.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/100). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-aim mode; trigger it in a firefight with at least five enemies close together and drop all five before it ends. Crowded shootouts are the place to try it.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave Vice City International Airport in a way the airport did not schedule. The description is deliberately vague; the plain reading is to take an aircraft out of the airport outside a mission. Try stealing an aircraft on the airfield and flying off. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the official description, so treat this as a best reading, not a confirmed step.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — the Rhinos are tanks, so this involves a tank. The cryptic description hides the exact trigger; the plain reading is to get into a Rhino tank and cause mayhem with it. Steal one from a military area and see what the game counts. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the official description.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the requirement: get in, take the goods and get out with no alarm and no witness raising one. Go at a quiet hour, move slowly and avoid the cameras and the guards' sightlines.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape; PlayStation tracks 0/5. Bank vaults are bigger jobs than shops — plan each one, then escape the wanted level after. Five successful vault jobs, each with a clean getaway, is the target.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/5). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida; intercept one, crack it open and lose the heat afterwards. One clean truck job is all it takes.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida; PlayStation tracks 0/52 areas. Fifty-two areas make up the map, from Vice City to the swamps and keys. The in-game map shows what you have visited — sweep the edges and the small towns last, since they are the easiest to miss.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/52). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang; PlayStation tracks 0/9 gangs. There are nine gangs, each with illegal operations to rob. One operation per gang — nine robberies in total, spread across the map's gang territories.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/9). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. The trophy's trick is the place, not the drink — any cocktail at the right spot should do.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's frontage and out the other side — the 'classic style' nod is to the series' old showroom-smashing moments. Pick a showroom with a clear run out.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the bowling alley run by Kolt & Associates and bowl a game — 'follow-through' suggests completing a full game rather than a single throw. Finish the game and it should pop.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description gives almost nothing away, so the trigger is tied to the two protagonists doing something together that draws a crowd. Try the partner activities and public stunts — the exact trigger is not pinned down in the official description, so treat this as a best reading, not a confirmed step.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse) — PlayStation tracks progress to 500. Five hundred choices is a long grind of small decisions made across the game, from dialogue options to actions in missions. It accumulates over a full playthrough, so do not chase it early; check the counter late.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/500). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The plain reading is to fail something and succeed on the retry — a second attempt that lands. If a mission or challenge goes wrong, try it again right away rather than reloading an old save.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is the trigger — an unusual encounter or event somewhere in Leonida. Keep an eye out for the odd and the unexplained while exploring, especially at night and off the beaten track. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the official description.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A melee drive-by means striking someone from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon, not a gun. Line up a target on foot, drive past and swing — ten-pin refers to knocking them flat.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts; PlayStation tracks 0/250000. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and contacts launder them for clean cash. Keep laundering after every big score and the total climbs.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/250000). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops; PlayStation tracks 0/100000. Any spending counts — clothes, weapons, food, car mods. It adds up over a playthrough, and big purchases like vehicles push it along fast.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/100000). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties; PlayStation tracks 0/8. Eight garages are for sale around Leonida. Buy them all — they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/8). Guide: our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app; PlayStation tracks 0/10. The Scooter Bros app takes vehicle registrations — register ten different vehicles through it. Any ten you own or find will do.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade). PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN target 0/10). Guide: our own reading of the official description.
